tools.name: create_group_vote
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a group to vote or pick between options: a poll, a ranked-choice vote, approval voting, choosing a date, venue, book or name. Publishes a voting page that people open from a link in any browser, and returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Methods: si

tools.name: show_vote_results
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the current or final results of a vote made with create_group_vote. Takes the private organizer link (contains /m/). Returns the number of voters, totals per option, the leader or winner or a tie, and for ranked choice the round-by-round instant-runoff count. Does not ch

tools.name: close_group_vote
tools.description: Use this when the organizer wants to stop voting (or open it again) on a vote made with create_group_vote. Takes the private organizer link. Closing shows the final result on the public page, also when totals were hidden. Set reopen true to accept votes again. Does not delete votes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_group_vote" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
